policies.text: Co-marketing grant allocation is approved for any vendor holding Gold tier status that submits a joint promotional proposal exceeding $75,000 in committed funds.
Green Channel Tier 1 vendor ranking is awarded to any logistics supplier holding a valid EcoVadis Gold rating.
Platinum partner tier recognition requires an annual software revenue of at least $5,000,000 and 25 certified client implementations.
Express procurement channel access is granted to suppliers with at least five years of continuous operational history.

Partner status at the Gold tier is granted to any vendor that either achieves an annual software revenue of at least $2,000,000 alongside a minimum of 10 certified client implementations, or maintains a valid ISO 27001 accreditation.
